items.title: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty signals gap-up open; Asia mkts rebound as dip-buyers return to tech
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Thursday: The GIFT Nifty indicated a gap-up open for the Nifty50 index. Asian markets rebounded as dip-buyers saved technology stocks

items.title: LCC Projects hits 10% upper band on order win; but 40% below IPO price
items.description: LCC Projects' stock listed on the Indian bourses on September 17. However, it remains 6.40 per cent below the initial public offering (IPO) price of ₹146 and 40 per cent off the all-time high of ₹191.

items.title: After strong rally, NSE stock seems to fully capture near-term positives
items.description: India's dominant exchange enjoys strong growth prospects, high margins and a robust balance sheet, but regulatory risks and its sharp post-listing rally warrant caution.
